中国香港、中国澳门、中国台湾、韩国及中东欧国家映射到 MSCI 新兴市场: 中国: Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, South Korea and Central and Eastern European countries map to MSCI Emerging Markets. Taiwan, South Korea, Poland, Czechia and Hungary are in that index. Hong Kong counts as developed in MSCI's classification but its market is closely tied to mainland China, and Macau has no local stock market, so both map there too. Eurozone members map to the DAX. High-income European countries outside the eurozone, plus Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore and Israel, map to MSCI ACWI. All other countries default to emerging markets.

心血管疾病,主要包括缺血性心脏病(冠心病)和脑卒中(中风)。高血压、吸烟、高胆固: Cardiovascular disease, mainly ischaemic (coronary) heart disease and stroke. High blood pressure, smoking, high cholesterol, diabetes and lack of exercise are the main risk factors.
恶性肿瘤,常见的致死类型包括肺癌、结直肠癌、肝癌、胃癌和乳腺癌等。发病风险随年龄: Malignant tumours. Common fatal types include lung, colorectal, liver, stomach and breast cancer. Risk rises markedly with age.
慢性呼吸系统疾病,主要为慢性阻塞性肺疾病(慢阻肺)和哮喘。吸烟、室内外空气污染和: Chronic respiratory disease, mainly COPD and asthma. Smoking, indoor and outdoor air pollution and workplace dust are the main risk factors.
糖尿病及慢性肾脏病。长期高血糖和高血压会损害肾脏、心血管等器官,部分患者最终死于: Diabetes and chronic kidney disease. Long-term high blood sugar and blood pressure damage the kidneys, heart and other organs, and some patients eventually die of kidney failure or other complications.
消化系统疾病,主要包括肝硬化、消化性溃疡、肠梗阻和胰腺炎等。肝硬化常与乙型或丙型: Digestive disease, mainly cirrhosis, peptic ulcers, bowel obstruction and pancreatitis. Cirrhosis is often linked to hepatitis B or C infection and long-term drinking.
神经系统疾病,主要包括阿尔茨海默病及其他痴呆、帕金森病和癫痫等。痴呆导致的死亡主: Neurological disease, mainly Alzheimer's and other dementias, Parkinson's and epilepsy. Deaths from dementia occur mostly at very old ages.
下呼吸道感染,主要为细菌或病毒引起的肺炎和支气管炎。五岁以下儿童和老年人风险最高: Lower respiratory infection, mainly bacterial or viral pneumonia and bronchitis. Risk is highest for children under five and for older people.
腹泻病,由细菌、病毒或寄生虫感染引起,可导致严重脱水。与缺乏安全饮用水和卫生设施: Diarrhoeal disease, caused by bacteria, viruses or parasites, can lead to severe dehydration. It is linked to a lack of safe water and sanitation, and risk is highest for children under five.
结核病、艾滋病毒感染/艾滋病和疟疾,三者均可预防和治疗。死亡主要集中在中低收入国: Tuberculosis, HIV/AIDS and malaria, all of which can be prevented and treated. Deaths are concentrated in low- and middle-income countries, and malaria deaths mostly strike young children in sub-Saharan Africa.
新生儿疾病与先天异常,包括早产并发症、出生窒息与产伤、新生儿败血症、先天性心脏病: Neonatal disease and birth defects, including complications of premature birth, birth asphyxia and trauma, neonatal sepsis, congenital heart disease and sudden infant death syndrome. These occur mainly in the first month and early infancy.
孕产相关死亡,指妊娠期间或分娩后 42 天内因妊娠相关原因导致的死亡。常见原因包: Maternal death: death from pregnancy-related causes during pregnancy or within 42 days of childbirth. Common causes include bleeding after birth, high blood pressure in pregnancy and infection.
道路交通伤害,包括行人、骑自行车者、摩托车骑乘者和机动车乘员在道路交通碰撞中受到: Road injury: fatal injuries to pedestrians, cyclists, motorcyclists and vehicle occupants in road collisions.
因自我伤害导致的死亡。世界卫生组织指出,可及的心理健康支持和限制获取致命手段有助: Death from self-harm. The World Health Organization notes that accessible mental health support and limits on access to lethal means help prevent suicide.
他人蓄意伤害造成的人际暴力死亡,以及战争、武装冲突和执法行动中的死亡。: Deaths from deliberate harm by others, and deaths in war, armed conflict and law enforcement.
其他非故意伤害,包括跌倒、溺水、火灾与烧烫伤、中毒、机械性伤害和自然灾害等。: Other unintentional injuries, including falls, drowning, fires and burns, poisoning, machinery injuries and natural disasters.
未归入以上类别的其他死因,例如脑膜炎、麻疹和百日咳等其他传染病、营养不良、药物和: Other causes not listed above, such as meningitis, measles, whooping cough and other infectious diseases, malnutrition, drug and alcohol use disorders, blood and endocrine disease and urogenital disease.
该年龄组每千人每年死亡数(全死因, 含 COVID-19): Deaths per thousand people a year in this age group (all causes, including COVID-19)
